author: Ankit
problem: Read a string S of 'X' and '.' characters and an integer K. You may change at most K of the '.' characters to 'X'; print the maximum possible length of a run of consecutive 'X's.
bug_description: The window loop stops at len(s)-k-1 instead of len(s)-k, so the last window of K+1 blocks (the one ending at the end of S) is never tried.

comments.accurate: Slides a window over K+1 consecutive X-blocks (filling the K dots between them) and keeps the longest span
comments.wrong_behavior: Slides a window of K+1 X-blocks over every start except the last, whose span the earlier windows already cover
comments.wrong_location: Window bounds verified; check the prefix sums when S starts or ends with a dot
